brief.text:
Brief

Layout: one batch per row, 3 creatives (C1, C2, C3), with the IM8 references in the narrow column on the left.
Naming: Men: M Batch 467 - C1, C2, C3, then 468, 469… Women: W Batch 415 - C1, C2, C3, then 416…
A batch is men only or women only, never mixed (and no ad shows both).
Three IM8 references per batch, one per creative: C1, C2 and C3 each copy their own IM8 ad closely, stacked in the narrow column on the left.
Product: 3x Minimal Stack Set (men's black / silver / gold, women's gold); the 2x Duo Minimal Set joins from Run 2. Photos come from the live Shopify listings and the clean (no text) frames in Figma, Static Ads 2.
Offer: Black Friday, 30% off sitewide, no code, taken off at checkout.
No prices or currencies on any ad: the same ads run in the EUR and USD accounts, so the offer is always told as 30% off.
Facts used: waterproof, sweat and heat resistant · recycled 316L stainless steel · adjustable S/M/L · "case included" with sets (never "free case") · free shipping · Trustpilot 4.5, 3,000+ reviews.
Safe zones: no key text in the top 270 px or bottom 384 px.
Each ad copies the layout idea of an IM8 ad, rebuilt in Cavaier's look: graphite monochrome (black, white, light grey), Figtree, square black or white buttons. Keep backgrounds light: no large black or dark fields dominating the ad; black is for type, buttons and small accents. Red #A82C24 only as a small accent, and only on light monochrome layouts; never on dark or full-colour photo ads.
Lanes: men on the left, women on the right, never mixed. Videos (Seedance 2.5): a batch is an ad set. Videos made from a static batch form their own video batch (new number, new ad set), in the video lane right beside that batch's row, filling C1, C2, C3, then a new video batch. The statics stay live.
Every ad passes a ROAS check before it ships: text contrast, safe zones, offer readable at feed size, one clear hook. The copy sticky next to each batch says what changed.
Copy: headline and description at most 27 characters so they don't cut off in feed.
Imitation: copy the reference's structure literally. Text and checklists sit straight on the photo the way IM8 does it, never in a box that hides the product.
Commands: comment on an ad and send it to Claude (redo, video, 720p / 1080p, reject, mp4, push to clickup and frame), see the red COMMANDS note. A comment is the go-ahead; no extra confirmation.
Men vs women photos: a product name with a dash is the women's version ("3x Minimal - Stack Set"), without a dash it's the men's ("3x Minimal Stack Set", "2x Duo Minimal Set"). Men's ads use only photos from the men's listings and men's Figma frames.
Format: every static, video draft and approved video is delivered at 1080x1920 (9:16). Approved videos are rendered by Seedance 2.5 from the exact draft at the resolution written in the comment ("720p" or "1080p"); the delivered file is always 1080x1920.
Work in progress: the moment a redo or video starts, a blue IN PROGRESS box goes into the exact slot it will land in, and is replaced when it's done.
Frame.io (approved batches): the batch folder and its EN and "no text" subfolders always exist already. Only find them, never create folders. Text version → EN, clean version → no text. The batch folder link is in the batch's ClickUp task (Creatives field).
Activity: the blue ACTIVITY & QUEUE note above Evergreen lists running and finished jobs (Seedance, Frame.io, ClickUp) with times; updated when a job starts and when it ends. Delivered batches also get FRAME ✓ / CLICKUP ✓ in their titles.
Sound: every video is generated WITH SOUND (Seedance generate_audio true), drafts and finals, and the delivered MP4 keeps the audio.
Queue: every comment command goes into the QUEUE list on the ACTIVITY & QUEUE note right away (QUEUED → RUNNING → DONE). Commands on the same ad are merged and the latest wins; Seedance work arriving within ~2 min is sent as one job; a job already running is never restarted for a later command unless that command changes the same ad.
Language: everything on the canvas, in replies and in deliverables is in English.
Seedance sound: generate_audio true goes on the DRAFT request; the final (draft_task) request must not carry it and inherits the draft's sound. Old silent drafts can't become finals with sound, so they need a new draft with sound.
Status tags: every creative carries a tag stack top left (not part of the exported ad): DRAFT / RENDERING / FINAL for videos, then CLICKUP ✓ DONE and FRAME ✓ UPLOADED (blue while running) once delivered.
ClickUp: on the batch task fill the copy fields (Preview Text, Subject Line, Description, EU URL, US URL). On each C1–C3 row set Creative Style, Angle, Creative Origin, Funnel Stage and Offer, and leave a short, clean comment saying what that creative tests (name the IM8 ad it imitates; no tool names like Seedance or Claude). Creative Origin is Imitation for IM8-based creatives, including their video versions. Don't put Frame links in the rows.
Sections: BLACK FRIDAY on the left, EVERGREEN on the right (its own rules note). The full technical rulebook is CLAUDE.md in the Cavaier/Claude repo.
ClickUp batch task (mother): for Creative Style, Angle, Creative Origin, Funnel Stage and Offer, if C1–C3 all share the same value, set it on the batch task too; if they differ, leave it.
Photos: every new batch pulls fresh product photos from the Cavaier Figma file (node 17-2). Photos already on the canvas can be reused, but a batch is never built only from them.
Type: high-end and airy, never chunky (reference: M Batch 473 C1). Headline ~50 px, light weight, slight letter spacing; body ~27 px light, narrow column; small logo (~110 px); slim button; lots of white space.

redo.text:
COMMANDS (comment to Claude)

Click an ad, press C (or the comment icon), write a command and send it to Claude:

redo: new IM8 reference (static) or new draft (video), rebuilt in the same slot.
video: a Seedance 2.5 draft with sound in the video ad set next to it. The static stays live.
720p / 1080p: the draft is rendered as a final at the resolution you write, with sound, delivered as 1080x1920, replacing the draft.
reject: new prompt, new draft.
mp4: Claude sends you the video file in the chat.

Add a few words on what was off or which motion you want.

Video labels: yellow DRAFT · 480p = draft, blue RENDERING = being rendered, green FINAL = approved final.
Blue IN PROGRESS box = Claude is working on it, in the slot where it will land.
Several comments at once are fine: they queue on the ACTIVITY & QUEUE note.

ev-brief.text:
Evergreen · rules

Normal, always-on ads. No Black Friday, no 30% off, no discount or deadline language.
Same setup as Black Friday: one batch per row (C1, C2, C3), three IM8 references per batch, men and women in separate lanes, videos in the video lane beside the source batch.
Same brand and claims: graphite monochrome, Figtree. NO red in Evergreen, not even as an accent. Facts: waterproof, sweat and heat resistant · recycled 316L stainless steel · adjustable S/M/L · case included with sets · free shipping · Trustpilot 4.5, 3,000+ reviews.
No prices or currencies.
Evergreen batch numbers: men start at M Batch 445 and count up from there.
Ask for a batch with: "run evergreen batch" (men, women or both).
